Spatial prediction
Boat Shed and Salt-store frontage make a pause before the
final B exposure. The shore still has no climb out of the
ravine toe. Salt loft and Customs road bring different
reserve arrivals; the ground plant area remains outside
the civic bridge observation.
Support / opposing response
Rounding M10 loses immediate support from the shore
follower. O02 hides only selected ground crouch exposures;
the descending players can gain height over it. A B
defender pushing the bend gives up some site control.
Affected: M10, M11, M12, M19, M20, I08, O02, S5a, S5b, R6.
Walk routes: R03, R05, R06, R10. All circles are body
centers, not measured camera poses.

L02 / geometry prediction. Later capture each listed stance from both sides, include the follower, and inspect standing/crouched exposure plus all intermediate stair or ramp
positions. Roofs and slabs remain opaque. Movement openings and observation apertures are different contracts.
